subject: Final invoice, escrow release & withholding — Solstice AI account closure
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@solstice.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Solstice AI Accounting <accounts-payable@solstice.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Final invoice + escrow release timing for Solstice AI

Hi Monica,

Thanks — we're preparing the final payment for the Redwood contract that winds down on 31-Dec. Can you confirm when we will receive the final invoice and whether Redwood will release the escrowed credits at the same time? Our procurement team needs invoice details that match the PO for payment processing.

A couple of specifics from our side:
- We will apply the local withholding tax of 5% unless Redwood provides documentation to gross-up.
- We need the invoice to reference PO #67821 and include your VAT registration number.
- If possible, please include the expected payment date so our treasury can schedule the wire.

Attaching the PO for reference.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Finance Manager | Solstice AI
[Attachment: Solstice_PO_67821.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@solstice.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2026 11:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Final invoice + escrow release timing for Solstice AI

Hi Ellen — thanks for the PO.

We can get the final invoice out by COB Tuesday (2026-12-08). Plan below:
- 2026-12-08: Redwood issues final invoice (PDF) referencing PO #67821 and our VAT ID.
- 2026-12-09 to 2026-12-10: Accounting processes; escrow release request submitted once funds due are confirmed.

On the withholding point: if Solstice can confirm you will gross-up (i.e., remit the full gross amount to Redwood and record the WHT separately), we can issue the invoice without netting. Otherwise, we will accept net payment and issue a remittance confirmation and tax documentation. Laura, can you confirm if legal needs to review the gross-up wording? Aditya — can you confirm wire instructions and whether we can accommodate a net payment reconciliation for our year-end close?

I will attach the draft final invoice in my next email.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Lead, Renewals | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment planned: Redwood_Final_Invoice_20261208.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@solstice.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Solstice AI Accounting <accounts-payable@solstice.ai>, Marco Silva <marco.silva@solstice.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2026 08:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Final invoice + escrow release timing for Solstice AI

Thanks, Monica.

We will not gross-up by default. We typically apply the 5% withholding at source and provide the WHT certificate afterwards. I’m attaching our standard withholding form and a copy of the PO again.

Please provide:
- Redwood bank/wire instructions (incl. IBAN) to match against our payment rails.
- The invoice PDF with VAT ID and the line-by-line amounts so our AP system can match.

Targeting payment on 2026-12-15 once approvals are complete.

Regards,
Ellen
[Attachment: Solstice_WHT_Form.pdf (PDF, 25KB); Solstice_PO_67821.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@solstice.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 13:55:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Final invoice + escrow release timing for Solstice AI

Hi Ellen / Monica — looping finance in. A few clarifications from Redwood Finance:

- If Solstice pays net (after 5% WHT), Redwood can accept the net amount and will provide the WHT certificate with the remittance advice. For year-end recognition we will record the payment as received net and create a tax credit file for the withheld amount.
- If Solstice prefers to gross-up, we will need the tax treaty / authority statement so we can refund the WHT after review.

Bank details (provisional) for wire (please confirm the exact reference to include PO#: 67821 and Redwood invoice number):
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: Eastbridge Bank EU
IBAN: GB29EGBK10201530093459
BIC/SWIFT: EGBKGB2L
Reference: Solstice PO 67821 / Invoice TBD

We can accommodate a net payment schedule and will request escrow release once the net payment is received and processed. If you can confirm payment date (2026-12-15), we will align our collections team to clear and submit the escrow release request on 2026-12-16.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@solstice.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Final invoice + escrow release timing for Solstice AI

Ellen — attaching the signed final invoice now (Redwood_Final_Invoice_20261208.pdf).

Recap and asks:
- Invoice references PO #67821, Redwood VAT ID GB998877665, invoice total EUR 152,000 (line items included).
- Redwood will accept the net payment approach (apply 5% WHT). Please send the remittance advice once payment is initiated.
- We will request escrow release once we confirm receipt of cleared funds. Target: Redwood submits escrow release request on 2026-12-16 after processing.
- If Solstice can provide the official WHT certificate after payment, we will attach it to the payment record and issue any necessary tax documentation for your records.

Attachments: Redwood_Final_Invoice_20261208.pdf (signed).

Please confirm payment date and which AP contact will send the remittance advice so we can watch for it.

Thanks for the smooth close this quarter — happy to coordinate any follow-ups next week.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Lead, Renewals | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Final_Invoice_20261208.pdf (PDF, 76KB)]
